question: ABCD is a trapeznun in which BC | AD and AC = CD. If angle ABC = 74° and angle BAC = 54° , then what is the measure of ∠ACD (in degree)?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In ΔABC, ∠BCA = 180° − (74° + 54°) = 52°.

Since BC || AD, alternate interior angle ∠CAD = ∠BCA = 52°.

In ΔACD (where AC = CD), opposite angles are equal, so ∠ADC = ∠CAD = 52°.

∠ACD = 180° − (52° + 52°) = 76°.

**∴ The correct answer is 76°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**
